verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so letting users plug in external MCP servers for it to call is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents the opposite role: an official Sentry MCP server that exposes Sentry's data to outside AI assistants. Nothing shows Seer or any other part of Sentry acting as an MCP client that connects to user-supplied MCP servers.
